summaries.Romania: Romania's government faces fiscal pressure with debate over PNRR fund access and budget constraints, while cybersecurity vulnerabilities in critical infrastructure remain a concern. Key political figures clash over economic policy and EU funding management.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation continues with gene therapy developments and payment reform, while public health concerns emerge around measles mortality and vaccine hesitancy. AI integration in clinical settings raises both opportunities and implementation challenges.
summaries.Tech: Apple launches its first touchscreen Mac and foldable iPhone amid strong hardware sales, while AI agents proliferate across tech giants. Security vulnerabilities in Linux and emerging cyber threats demand immediate attention.

items.title: STAT+: Novartis cites cases of previously unknown tumors possibly tied to its SMA gene therapy
items.snippet: Novartis has acknowledged seven previously unknown instances in which tumors were found in children who were treated with its spinal muscular atrophy therapy, Zolgensma.
items.line: Novartis acknowledges previously unknown tumors in children treated with Zolgensma SMA gene therapy, raising safety concerns.

items.title: CVS Health plans to split pharmacy business from Aetna, Caremark
items.snippet: CVS Health is splitting up. The healthcare giant announced Wednesday morning that it would divide its business units into two companies.
items.line: CVS Health plans to split pharmacy business from Aetna and Caremark in major structural reorganization of healthcare services.

items.title: Meet *sshole, the vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices
items.snippet: Certain configurations of Alpine are affected. Other distros may be as well.
items.line: Alpine Linux and other distributions vulnerable to critical SSH authentication bypass, affecting millions of Linux devices globally.

items.title: Niculescu: Impozitul minim pe cifra de afaceri dispare de la 1 ianuarie 2027. Premierul mizează pe stimularea investițiilor și a productivității
items.snippet: Impozitul minim pe cifra de afaceri va fi eliminat de la 1 ianuarie 2027, iar Guvernul mizează pe această măsură și pe planul de relansare economică pentru stimularea investițiilor și creșterea productivității companiilor, a declarat premierul Luca Niculescu. „România trebuie să producă mai mult, co
items.line: Romania eliminates minimum tax on turnover from 2027, betting on investment stimulation despite budget pressures.

items.title: Natalia Intotero: Regret că s-au pierdut foarte mulţi bani din PNRR. Ministerul Mediului a avut peste 3,6 miliarde de euro
items.snippet: Ministerul Mediului, Apelor şi Pădurilor a avut la dispoziţie fonduri de peste 3,6 miliarde de euro prin PNRR, din care a reuşit să acceseze puţin peste 1,3 miliarde de euro, a declarat, joi, la Petroşani, ministrul de resort, Natalia Intotero.
items.line: Romania risks losing €3.4B from PNRR with only €1.3B of €3.6B accessed by Environment Ministry, signaling implementation challenges.

items.title: Child dies of measles in Wisconsin’s first such death since 1990
items.snippet: An infant in southwestern Wisconsin has died after contracting measles, the state’s first death from the disease in 36 years.
items.line: Wisconsin reports first measles death since 1990 amid declining vaccination rates, highlighting public health vulnerability.

items.title: What Democratic control of Congress means for healthcare in 2027
items.snippet: Tuesday’s forecast-busting blue wave puts wind in the sails of Democrats who have promised a stark departure from Trump-era healthcare policy—though whether or not the shifts will be incremental or seismic hinges on intra-party debates and the president’s veto.
items.line: Democratic control of Congress could reshape healthcare with potential expansion of Medicare for All and regulatory shifts.

items.title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
items.snippet: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.
items.line: Airbnb announces AI travel agent launching in H1 2027 to handle trip planning, booking, and customer support.

items.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027

items.line: OpenAI president says company could be IPO-ready in 2027, signaling accelerating enterprise growth.
